{{recipe}}

Infused oils like this '''rosemary garlic oil''' can be easily made in your own home.

== Ingredients ==
* ½ gallon any flavorless high-smoke point [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|oil]], such as [[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola]], grapeseed, [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut]], or [[Cookbook:Safflower Oil|safflower]]
* 6 sprigs [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 20 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==
#Heat the oil in your tallest largest pot over low heat. Add remaining ingredients and warm for 1 hour.
#[[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] and keep in an airtight container. Some may want to keep this in the refrigerator, others may not.
